proposal.observation: detected_lines.png shows all 10 magenta vertical ring joints (ring_count_error=0, spacing ~365 px), but oblique line yield is very low: only ~8 short green/red oblique segments across 10 rings, while ~30 blue horizontal fallback segments carry most of the K-block evidence. initial_prompt_points.png confirms this: 7 of 12 prompt centres are 'assume' (green diamonds) and only 3 are direct negative/positive-slope intersections plus 2 midpoints, so most prompt centres are inferred rather than detected. The binarised outlier map shows the K-block chevron edges as faint dotted arcs rather than continuous strokes. depth_map_viridis.png is cleanly unrolled (no banding, orient_agreement 0.94, unfold_residual 2.67) with moderate holes at the left column and top/bottom margins (depth_nan_ratio 0.226). segmentation_results.png recovers 10 rings with staggered K blocks, but the weak prompt evidence is consistent with the low correspondence_f1@15 = 0.365 and chamfer 80 px, the dominant weakness relative to the other three proxy measurements.
proposal.rule: d7: m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered -> f_missing_lines; precondition check via d6/inter_stage_dependencies: faint dotted joint strokes in the outlier map indicate stage_3 f_joint_oversmoothed is a likely upstream contributor, so remediate both r_lower_depth_threshold-analogue (enhancing.curvature_threshold down) and r_relax_hough (lower hough_threshold_oblique, raise maxLineGap_oblique).
proposal.rationale: The unrolling and ring count are healthy, so unfolding and denoising are left untouched even though stage-1 is unlocked; the two dev examples that perturbed unfolding/denoising jointly (s005, s016) both broke ring_count_error and collapsed correspondence_f1@15. The closest analogue is complex-correspondencef1at15-improve-s021 (same dominant concern, same family, expected_rings=10), whose improving overlay used a low curvature_threshold (0.00037), a low oblique Hough threshold (27) and a high oblique maxLineGap (74) and raised correspondence_f1@15 0.446->0.460 with ring_count_error staying 0 and depth_nan_ratio slightly improving. This proposal takes the same direction but stays a targeted three-parameter change: lowering curvature_threshold marks more of the faint chevron points as joint points so the outlier map carries continuous oblique strokes; lowering hough_threshold_oblique and raising maxLineGap_oblique let HoughLinesP link those dotted strokes into oblique lines, replacing 'assume'/horizontal-fallback prompt centres with direct slope intersections and improving boundary correspondence. Joint outcome expected; no per-parameter attribution claimed. All values are inside configs/bounds/complex.json.
